name: Stepping Stones
summary: A weathered note in the Barrens points travelers toward Stepping Stones, a mountain refuge near Desolace. It says two couriers made deliveries for the New Plague, and calls what happened to them simple apothecary accidents.

sections.title: A Note in the Wilds
sections.body: A torn message hangs from a wooden plank at a backcountry camp in the Barrens. Mercenaries, cutthroats, and drifters pass through such camps for brief shelter, far from the eyes of the Crossroads or Ratchet. Among the wilds' ordinary signs, the note offers a reason to look beyond the camp and toward the mountains.

sections.title: Whispers of the New Plague
sections.body: The anonymous writer says two agents made deliveries for the New Plague, then calls what happened to them simple apothecary accidents. The note invites you to meet at a mountain refuge between the Barrens and Desolace, where the matter can be discussed in safety.

faq.q: What is the note found in Stepping Stones talking about?
faq.answer: The note says two couriers making deliveries for the New Plague met sudden ends, which the writer calls simple apothecary accidents. The writer offers a mountain meeting place to discuss what happened.

faq.q: Where does the note tell you to go?
faq.answer: The writer directs you to a secluded refuge in the mountains between the Barrens and Desolace.

faq.q: What is the New Plague mentioned in the letter?
faq.answer: The New Plague is a deadly concoction developed in Undercity by the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society. It is meant to destroy both the Scourge and living enemies, and its testing and courier runs across the continents carry secrecy and fatal danger.

faq.q: Who wrote the note pinned to the plank?
aliases: who is waiting in the mountains
faq.answer: The note is anonymous and pinned to a rough wooden plank at a backcountry camp. Its writer offers a mountain meeting place between the Barrens and Desolace.

faq.q: Why would couriers for the Forsaken be in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Forsaken apothecaries gather exotic venoms, spores, and reagents from Kalimdor's flora and fauna, then coordinate shipments through Horde outposts and wilderness routes.

faq.q: Why are backcountry camps used for notes like this?
faq.answer: Outside major settlements, the Barrens is sprawling and loosely governed. Neutral waystations, mercenary rest spots, and rogue camps let travelers, smugglers, and informers leave word discreetly, away from the Horde and regional watch posts.

angles.text: For Forsaken travelers, a rogue mention of the Royal Apothecary Society and its blight research is an urgent security matter, or a dangerous conspiracy from within.
As a Horde wanderer in the Barrens, you must weigh whether reports of lethal plague deliveries on Kalimdor soil threaten your lands and alliances.
As a rogue, you know how to track anonymous informants and judge covert messages left between Desolace and the Barrens.
